validation_runtime.method: Official PSF NuGet Windows x64 runtime in an isolated venv. The traditional installer was signature/hash checked; MSI installation failed on this validation host before installing core.msi.

notice_review: Original runtime LICENSE.txt copied from this distribution; matching OpenSSL 3.0.16 and XZ 5.2.5 notices added. VC runtime 14.42 uses the existing 2015-2022 recipient terms. Other Python/native wheel dependencies remain pinned. Historical supplemental notices are retained as a superset; the actual bundle is listed in component-inventory.json.
